articles.summary: PriceSmart, Inc. ("PriceSmart" or the "Company") (NASDAQ: PSMT), operator of 56 warehouse clubs in 12 countries and one U.S. territory, today announced results for the fiscal first quarter of 2026, which ended on November 30, 2025. First Quarter Financial Results Total revenues for the first quarter of fiscal year 2026 increased 9.9% to $1.38 billion compared to $1.26 billion in the comparable period of the prior year.
